summary: Comprehensive implementation plan to refine Excel bulk student upload in admin portal: align mapping schema with exact 13 manual Add Student form fields (merging UID/Samastha Reg ID duplicate, omitting Class and Photo), add duplicate column mapping detection with high-visibility solid red alert, upgrade validation styling to rich vibrant high-contrast colors, implement an interactive "+ Add Field" modal/dropdown to add unmapped columns, and render blank cells cleanly without dashes.
